annotator: Codex assistant, independent manual blind review
sampling: Five previously unused comments per twelve held-out2026threads. Stable SHA256(final-blind-v1-ID) selection: up to three direct mentions and two nonmention replies per thread, then fill in hash order. All currentdataset+original144IDs excluded. Comment length30..1200 and parent<=1000, HTML normalized, emails skipped, no author fields. No sentiment or model predictions used for selection.
limitation: Exploratory assistant reference, not human ground truth. One annotator; implicit references and sarcasm remain ambiguous. Target mentions intentionally overrepresented:36of60comments, so this is a coverage audit, not an estimate of natural HN sentiment. No teacher/student predictions or previous reference labels consulted. Must not be used for prompt/model selection or student training.
targeting_rule: Judge only the comment toward ChatGPT, including clearly identifiable app/features. Immediate parent/title may resolve a clear referent, but a matching story title alone does not make a reply relevant. Do not inherit the parent sentiment. Other products, generic AI, people, politics and social issues are F without a sufficiently clear target connection. Neutral factual target comments are C.
